PDF reading in 1.24.39 -- an independent review (locks, forms, annotations, layers, bookmarks)
2026-11-25. Reviewer did not write the code. src/lantern.inner.html as of sha256 09ff7ac386c420d3 (branch lantern-1.24.39,
uncommitted). Run in Chromium (Playwright), the page being src/lantern.inner.html itself; "before" = the committed
site/index.html (1.24.38). 56 PDFs made here (make_fixtures.py: reportlab 5.0.1, pypdf 6.17.0, qpdf 11.9, pdftk-java, and
byte by byte); every one passes `qpdf --check`. Oracles: qpdf's unlocked copy (lock_base_decrypted.pdf) for text and
pixels; poppler (pdftotext, pdftoppm) for layers, comb fields and the Multiply highlight; ISO 32000 otherwise.

RESULT: 373 cases, 330 pass, 43 fail. Every case is in cases.json. To repeat:
  python3 make_fixtures.py ; LANTERN_OLD=<old index.html> python3 run_review.py

=====================================================================================================================
FAILURES (most serious first). Each: smallest reproduction, what happened, likely cause.
=====================================================================================================================

1. A LINEARIZED ("Fast Web View") LOCKED PDF OPENS AS BLANK PAGES, WITH NO ERROR AND NO PASSWORD ASKED   [9 cases]
   Repro: qpdf --linearize --encrypt "" ownpw 128 --use-aes=y -- lock_base.pdf lin_aes128_owner.pdf
          Lantern.pdf.open(that) -> security null, pageText "" on both pages, pageDraw all white.
          lin_rc4_128_owner.pdf the same. lin_aes256_user.pdf (user password "lantern") opens WITHOUT asking and
          shows blank pages; given the password, still blank.
   Cause: PDF_PARSE doc.ready, src line 47588-47597: the lock is looked for only in the LAST "trailer"
          (s.lastIndexOf("trailer")). In a linearized file the last trailer is the main section's, holding only
          /Size and /ID; /Encrypt, /Root and /Info are in the first-page trailer near the top of the file. The XRef-
          stream scan does not apply (classic tables). The fall-back test at line 47636 looks at the same last trailer
          and the last 4000 bytes, so the file is not even refused. Linearized is what Acrobat writes for "Fast Web
          View", so this is likely the commonest locked PDF a person meets. (lin_objstm_aes256_owner.pdf, linearized
          with cross-reference streams, PASSES.) A fix would read every trailer (or follow /Prev) for /Encrypt, /ID,
          /Root and /Info.
   Same cause, already in 1.24.38: the Info title of a linearized PDF is "" (lin_plain.pdf; PDF_PAGES open,
          line 48364).

2. TEXT STRINGS IN PDFDocEncoding OR UTF-8 ARE MISREAD (bookmark titles, field values)   [8 cases]
   Repro: a field /V (Bay 3 \205 East)  -> pageText "Bay: Bay 3 <U+0085> East" (expected "Bay 3 – East").
          pypdf's own outline items "Safety – first “quoted”", "Spare parts • list" -> "Safety <85> first <8D>quoted<8E>",
          "Spare parts <80> list"; reportlab+pypdf "Wiring – main panel" the same. pypdf WRITES every text string in
          PDFDocEncoding when it can, so this hits ordinary files (nav_rl_pypdf.pdf, form_hand.pdf, nav_deep.pdf).
          PDF 2.0 UTF-8 strings (EF BB BF ...) come out as mojibake: "ï»¿Wiring â panel Ã©tÃ©" (pdf20_utf8_strings.pdf).
   Cause: PDF_PAGES text(), line 48371-48374: UTF-16BE with BOM, else Latin-1. Bytes 0x80-0x9F (bullet, dagger,
          en/em dash, curly quotes, fi/fl, Euro at 0xA0 ...) need the PDFDocEncoding table; EF BB BF needs UTF-8.
          Used by PDF_ANNOTS tx(), PDF_NAV tx() and the Info title.

3. A HIGHLIGHT WITH ITS OWN DRAWING IN MULTIPLY BLEND (AS ACROBAT MAKES THEM) HIDES THE WORDS UNDER SOLID YELLOW   [1]
   Repro: annots_hand.pdf, a /Highlight whose /AP is "/GS0 gs 1 1 0 rg <rect> re f" with GS0 << /BM /Multiply /ca 1 >>
          over 16 pt black words. Lantern: region all yellow (255,255,0), 0% dark. poppler: 33% dark (words show).
   Cause: PDF_DRAW "gs" operator, line 49683: /BM (blend mode) is ignored, so an opaque Multiply fill paints over.
          (PDF_ANNOT_DRAW's own plain highlight does use multiply; only the appearance-stream path is wrong.)
          Line 49801 also sets globalAlpha 1 for every appearance, so an annotation's /CA is ignored there.

4. TEXT INSIDE A FORM XOBJECT THAT IS DRAWN IN A HIDDEN LAYER IS STILL READ   [1]
   Repro: content "/OC /B BDC /FmB Do EMC" with layer B off and FmB drawing "FORM-IN-B": pageText contains FORM-IN-B;
          pageDraw correctly leaves it out (layers_ocmd.pdf).
   Cause: PDF_TEXT pageText run(), line 48926: the hidden-count (mc, off) is local to each run(); the Do branch at
          line 48980 starts a nested run() with off = 0 and does not check the caller's off.

5. OPTIONAL-CONTENT VISIBILITY EXPRESSIONS (/VE) ARE IGNORED   [5]
   Repro: layers_ocmd.pdf, B off: OCMD << /VE [/And A B] >> -> shown (poppler hides it); OCMD with /OCGs [A B] /P /AnyOn
          AND /VE [/And A B] -> shown (VE must take precedence: hidden); with B turned on, OCMD /VE [/Not B] stays shown.
   Cause: PDF_ANNOTS ocVisible(), line 48707-48720: only /OCGs and /P are read; an OCMD with /VE and no /OCGs
          returns true. (/VE is PDF 1.6; less common than /P, but it is what Acrobat writes for some layer logic.)

6. A SCANNED PAGE'S PICTURE IN A LAYER THAT IS OFF IS STILL PAINTED FOR TEXT READER   [2]
   Repro: layers_scan_off.pdf: a full-page scan plus "/OC /Off BDC ... /Mark Do EMC" (layer off). pageDraw leaves the
          black mark out (PASS); pageImage and Text Reader's picture(doc, 0) paint it black.
   Cause: PDF_PAGES draws(), line 48383-48411, follows q/Q/cm/Do with no BDC/EMC or XObject /OC check; Text Reader's
          picture() (line 54809-54811) takes pageImage whenever the page has no annotations. Already so in 1.24.38;
          the new layer rule reaches pageDraw and pageText only.

7. fields() LISTS A RADIO GROUP ONCE PER BUTTON   [3]
   Repro: form_rl.pdf (reportlab radio "colour", green chosen) -> [{colour, Off}, {colour, green}, {colour, Off}];
          form_hand.pdf "shift" -> ["Off", "Night", "Off"]. Expected one field "colour" = "green".
   Cause: PDF_ANNOTS fields(), line 48672-48676, walks widgets, not fields (a field with several widgets -- radio
          buttons, or one value shown on two pages -- appears once per widget). pageText is right ("Colour: [ ] [x] [ ]").

8. A TICKED CHECK BOX WITH NO DRAWING OF ITS OWN REPORTS "Yes" WHATEVER ITS ON-NAME   [2]
   Repro: form_hand.pdf: << /FT /Btn /T (onbox) /V /On /AS /On >> (no /AP) -> fields() value "Yes" (expected "On").
          (With an /AP whose on-state is /Ja the value is right: "Ja".)
   Cause: PDF_ANNOTS field(), line 48609-48611: the on-name comes only from /AP /N keys; with none it falls back to
          "Yes" instead of /AS or /V.

9. A COMB FIELD WITH NO DRAWING IS DRAWN AS ORDINARY LEFT-ALIGNED TEXT   [2]
   Repro: form_hand.pdf: /Ff 16777216 (Comb) /MaxLen 5 /V (74070) in a 200 pt box, NeedAppearances true. The last
          cell (310-350) is blank in Lantern; poppler spaces the digits one per cell (last cell inked).
   Cause: PDF_ANNOT_DRAW, Widget branch at line 49909: no Comb/MaxLen handling (field() does not keep Ff or MaxLen).
          The value is read correctly. (reportlab's own comb appearance is left-aligned too; Lantern draws that as
          given, matching poppler -- PASS.)

10. BOOKMARKS DEEPER THAN 12 LEVELS ARE DROPPED SILENTLY   [2]
   Repro: nav_deep.pdf, 15 nested items: Deep 13-15 missing.   Cause: PDF_NAV outline(), line 48788 (depth < 12).
   Minor; a stated limit, but nothing tells the viewer items were left out.

11. A USER PASSWORD WITH A EURO SIGN DOES NOT OPEN A REVISION 2-4 LOCK   [1]
   Repro: qpdf --encrypt "€uro-5" ownpw 128 --use-aes=y (qpdf stores € as PDFDocEncoding 0xA0) ->
          open(.., {password:"€uro-5"}) -> "that password does not open this PDF". (The AES-256 copy opens.)
   Cause: PDF_CRYPT latin(), line 48081: characters above 255 become "?"; revisions 2-4 want PDFDocEncoding
          (€ 0xA0, – 0x85, “ 0x8D ...). Same table as failure 2.

12. MESSAGES FOR LOCKS LANTERN CANNOT OPEN   [4, all minor]
   - Any non-Standard handler is called "a certificate": "this PDF is locked with a FOPN_foweb lock (a certificate,
     not a password)" (unknown_handler.pdf); and "a Adobe.PubSec lock" reads wrongly (cert_pubsec.pdf). PDF_CRYPT
     unlock(), line 48126. (Both refuse cleanly, no crash, no password asked -- PASS.)
   - A damaged lock (O/U missing; revision 6 with no UE) asks for a password no one can give: needPassword true
     (damaged_lock_no_OU.pdf, damaged_lock_r6_no_UE.pdf). PDF_CRYPT line 48152; Text Reader would ask 5 times.

13. INFO TITLE OF A PDF WITH A CROSS-REFERENCE STREAM IS ""   [2, already so in 1.24.38]
   Repro: qpdf --object-streams=generate lock_base.pdf -> pdf.title "" (also when locked: qpdf_aes128_objstm.pdf).
   Cause: PDF_PAGES open(), line 48364, reads /Info only after the keyword "trailer".

14. A FIELD WHOSE /Parent POINTS TO ITSELF IS NAMED "loop.loop.loop..." (29 times)   [1, damaged file, minor]
   PDF_ANNOTS fullName()/inherit(), line 48594-48595: a 30-step cap but no seen-set. No hang.

=====================================================================================================================
WHAT PASSED (330 cases)
=====================================================================================================================
Locks: pdftk RC4-40 and RC4-128 (owner only; with user passwords; a Latin-1 user password "façade"; a 40-character
  password), pypdf AES-128 / AES-256 R5 / AES-256 R6 (non-ASCII user "Café-Ñandú" and owner "Größe-Ø"; the same password
  typed decomposed (NFD); a password set with a no-break space opened with an ordinary space), qpdf AES-128/256 and
  RC4 V4 with --cleartext-metadata (XMP comes out as XML in every case, scrambled or clear), --force-V4, --force-R5,
  object streams with a user password, no-print/no-copy permissions: each opens (or asks, refuses a wrong password
  with wrongPassword, opens with user or owner password, security.owner/userPassword right), and its text equals the
  unlocked text EXACTLY and both pages are pixel-identical to the unlocked PDF; Info title and UTF-16 bookmark decrypt.
  Incremental updates appended after the lock (AES-128, RC4-128, AES-256, and a classic update on an xref-stream file):
  the new scrambled content and title are read and drawn, untouched page 2 identical. A locked form whose values sit in
  object streams (not unscrambled twice) and a locked reportlab form read and draw identically to unlocked. Certificate
  and unknown handlers are refused with an error, no crash. Text Reader: asks, says the first try was wrong, opens with
  the second and reads; Cancel gives a plain error.
Forms: reportlab fields with appearances (text, check, radio, combo export->display, multi-select list, comb, read-only,
  page 2), hand-made fields with no appearances (hierarchical a.b.c names, a value inherited by widgets on two pages,
  radio group, list box exports, /Ja on-state, UTF-16 value, Q=1 centring, hidden field neither drawn nor read),
  pypdf-filled with and without NeedAppearances, a /Rotate 90 page (value beside its label, drawn in the right place).
Annotations: Text icon, FreeText, Line, Square/Circle fills, Polygon, PolyLine, Highlight (plain), Links not drawn,
  Underline/StrikeOut/Squiggly colours, Ink, Stamp by name and by appearance, Hidden/NoView (with or without an
  appearance) and Popup (even /Open true) never drawn or read, an annotation in an off layer hidden and shown again via
  pdf.layerOn, appearances with a far-off BBox, a turning /Matrix and a small BBox all mapped onto /Rect correctly,
  /CA 0.5 on a plain box, comments read with author under "Comments on this page:", popup text not doubled.
Layers: OCMD /AllOn /AnyOn /AnyOff /AllOff, a single-ref /OCGs, nested BDC/BMC inside a hidden part, a Form XObject
  with /OC = OCMD, an image inside a hidden BDC (pageDraw), BaseState /OFF with /ON, turning layers on and off.
Bookmarks/links: /Dests dict, Names tree with Kids/Limits (incl. a name equal to a bound, an unknown name -> -1, a
  << /D >> value), GoTo by string and by name, URI, UTF-16 titles, cycles in /Next and /First and a self-loop (no hang,
  each item once, under 1 ms).
Older PDFs (tests/fixtures/text_reader, pdf_open, sheets/ode_clarinet.pdf, docs/*.pdf, up to 40 pages): no errors;
  text and the first three pages' drawings identical to 1.24.38 except on pages that carry annotations or layers that
  are off (where the change is the intended one). Damaged PDF (null/junk annotations, short arrays, missing AP, OCGs not
  an array, broken outline items): nothing throws. No uncaught page errors in the whole run.

=====================================================================================================================
NOT TESTED
=====================================================================================================================
- PDFs from Acrobat itself (no Acrobat, no downloads): the linearized and Multiply-highlight cases were made with qpdf
  and by hand in Acrobat's form.
- A real certificate-locked file (only its /Encrypt dictionary was made); named crypt filters other than Identity on
  single streams (/Crypt with a name); EncryptMetadata false under AES-256 made by Acrobat.
- Signed signature fields, XFA forms, rich-text (/RC) comments, widget /MK rotation, NoRotate/NoZoom notes on turned
  pages, /D (down) appearances, print-only drawing (opts.print).
- The node (jsdom) path: everything ran in Chromium only.
- How any page looks to a person (Adam's call): only ink share and colour in regions were measured.
